name: amm
description: The Open Exchange's CONFIG app (shruggr/skein-amm#4, 0.17.0): the instance that enables tokens, one token instance per token id (the token app, the repository's root manifest, from the image the host holds as config["amm-config"].tokenImage, default amm-token). Root's messages in the box amm/admin (the role root gates enable, disable, defaults; the door's kernel.beef checks a BEEF against the host chain, so the chain app is required): {fn: "enable", args: {tokenId: "<txid>_<vout>", beef}} — the BEEF's subject the token id's transaction and its output <vout> a BRC-162 / BRC-161 deploy, else refused — records the token creating and asks the host's instance manager (the address book's local manager: the host names this instance in SKEIN_MANAGER_FOR) to create {handle: <tokenId>, image: <tokenImage>, config: {amm: {overlay: {topics: {tm_color_<tokenId>: color-topic}, lookups: {ls_color, ls_color_deploys, ls_amm, ls_color_<tokenId>}, terms?}, "amm-p2p": {market?}}}, beef} (terms and market from amm/defaults when set); on the answer the token is enabled with its url and the delivery's verdict, or failed {reason}; a stopped token is started again (start {handle}). {fn: "disable", args: {tokenId}}: stop {handle}, the token stopped. {fn: "defaults", args: {terms?: {lpFeeBps, validatorFeeBps, commissionBps} | null, market?: {minCommissionBps} | null}}: the defaults under amm/defaults (partial; null clears one), applied to the creates after it. Each answered to root in the box amm/admin {fn, request, result | error}. A holder's {fn: "request", args: {tokenId}} in the box amm/requests (anyone): recorded under amm/requests. Reads (anyone, nothing logged): /tokens, the enable list [{tokenId, topic, sym, dec, icon?, status, url?, since, reason?, delivered?}] newest first (state amm/tokens); /defaults, the defaults {terms?, market?}; /requests, the holders' requests less the tokens on the list; / the Swap pages (www/).
